name: W Amsterdam
positioning: A hotel spanning two heritage buildings by Dam Square, a 1906 bank and the former Royal Dutch Post communications center, with a rooftop pool and a spa in an old bank vault
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from Dam Square and the Royal Palace
Design and history lovers drawn to converted heritage buildings with a lively rooftop scene

facts.text: The hotel sits between the Royal Palace and the Singel Canal.
The former KAS Bank building was built in 1906.
One suite has views of the Royal Palace and Dam Square from the bed.
Some suites have a sunken bath in the bedroom; others have an open fire and rounded bed curves.
Bank building rooms use warm tones and gold accents, while Exchange building rooms lean almost futuristic.
Some Bank building rooms have gold minibars shaped like small bank vaults.
The spa's WET area includes a heated pool, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, Japanese fire bath and gold ice plunge pool.
The FIT gym has a canal view.
The W Lounge is a cocktail bar on the 6th floor.
MR PORTER is a rooftop steakhouse with house DJ sets.
X BANK is a concept store for Dutch art, fashion and design.

highlights.text: The hotel spans two heritage buildings, the former KAS Bank and the Royal Dutch Post's communications center, steps from Dam Square.
AWAY Spa is hidden in an old bank vault, a dimly lit underground haven.
The Wet Deck pool is on the roof of the Exchange building, overlooking the city.
One suite has a snooker table that transforms into a dining table for eight.
Gold lines on the W Lounge windows and slim copper pipes pay tribute to the telephone wires of the former exchange.

considerations.text: Advance appointments are required for all spa treatments and WET area access.
One pet up to 20 kg is allowed per room.
WhataHotel notes the lively atmosphere may not suit guests seeking a quiet retreat.
